Dump Cake For A Crowd
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 18, 2009 - 11:29pm

Ingredients




2 pkg. yellow cake mix
3 (29 oz.) cans fruit cocktail or canned pie
3/4 stick butter

Preparation

1 Pour fruit into Dutch oven. Sprinkle dry cake mix over fruit. Dot butter on top of cake mix. Cook until topping is lightly brown. Serves 24.
